entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the day you arrive in Malawi.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses después del día de llegada a Malaui.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive in Malawi.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: Arriving passengers must complete a Traveller Health Check form, available via QR code on arrival or in advance.
entry.es: Los pasajeros que llegan deben rellenar un formulario de control sanitario, disponible por código QR a la llegada o con antelación.
entry.quote: The Ministry of Health and Sanitation require arriving passengers to complete a Traveller Health Check form. This can be accessed on arrival through a QR code or completed in advance.

entry.en: Single or multiple entry visas can be obtained on arrival, and bringing US dollars in cash for payment is advised.
entry.es: Los visados de entrada única o múltiple pueden obtenerse a la llegada, y se aconseja llevar dólares estadounidenses en efectivo para pagar.
entry.quote: Single or multiple entry visas can be obtained on arrival. You are advised to bring US dollars in cash for payment:

entry.en: Online e-visas are available on the Malawi Immigration website.
entry.es: Hay visados electrónicos en línea en el sitio web de Inmigración de Malaui.
entry.quote: On-line e-visas are available on the Malawi Immigration website.

entry.en: All foreign currency must be declared upon arrival.
entry.es: Toda la divisa extranjera debe declararse a la llegada.
entry.quote: All foreign currency must be declared upon arrival

safety.en: Most thefts from tourists take place around main bus stations in urban areas.
safety.es: La mayoría de los robos a turistas ocurren cerca de las principales estaciones de autobuses urbanas.
safety.quote: Most thefts from tourists take place around main bus stations in urban areas.

safety.en: There are occasional reports of kidnappings for ransom in Malawi.
safety.es: Hay denuncias ocasionales de secuestros con fines de rescate en Malaui.
safety.quote: There are occasional reports of kidnappings for ransom in Malawi.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal and may result in a custodial sentence.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal y puede acarrear pena de cárcel.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal and may result in a custodial sentence.

safety.en: Driving in Malawi can be hazardous and there is a high rate of road fatalities.
safety.es: Conducir en Malaui puede ser peligroso y hay una alta tasa de muertes en carretera.
safety.quote: Driving in Malawi can be hazardous and there is a high rate of road fatalities.

safety.en: Cyclones and floods are common during the rainy season from November to April.
safety.es: Los ciclones y las inundaciones son frecuentes durante la temporada de lluvias, de noviembre a abril.
safety.quote: Cyclones and floods are common during the rainy season from November to April.

safety.en: Police sometimes ask to see ID, so always carry a copy of your passport, visa or residence permit.
safety.es: La policía a veces pide identificación, así que lleva siempre una copia de tu pasaporte, visado o permiso de residencia.
safety.quote: Police sometimes ask to see ID. Always carry a copy of your passport, visa or residence permit.

health.en: Malaria can be a problem in Malawi, as in neighbouring countries.
health.es: La malaria puede ser un problema en Malaui, como en los países vecinos.
health.quote: As with its neighbouring countries malaria can be a problem.

health.en: The lake is prone to bilharzia, especially in the Cape Maclear area.
health.es: El lago es propenso a la bilharzia, sobre todo en la zona de Cape Maclear.
health.quote: The lake is freshwater and is prone to bilharzia, especially in the Cape Maclear area.

health.en: Malawi had the largest cholera outbreak in its history in late 2022 and early 2023, and cases are likely to rise again in the rainy season.
health.es: Malaui sufrió el mayor brote de cólera de su historia a finales de 2022 y principios de 2023, y los casos probablemente aumenten en la temporada de lluvias.
health.quote: In late 2022 and early 2023, Malawi experienced the largest cholera outbreak in its history. Cases are likely to rise again during the rainy season.

health.en: Tap water may not be safe to drink, especially in rural areas.
health.es: Puede que el agua del grifo no sea potable, sobre todo en zonas rurales.
health.quote: Tap water may not be safe to drink, especially in rural areas.

health.en: Medical facilities in Malawi cannot provide the same standard of healthcare as in the UK, and rural facilities are basic.
health.es: Los centros médicos de Malaui no ofrecen el mismo nivel de atención que en el Reino Unido, y los rurales son básicos.
health.quote: General medical facilities throughout Malawi are unable to provide the same standard of healthcare as in the UK. Facilities in rural areas are basic and emergency services are limited.

health.en: Many medical facilities expect up-front payment.
health.es: Muchos centros médicos esperan el pago por adelantado.
health.quote: Many medical facilities expect up-front payment.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 998, fire 999 and police 990 or 997.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 998, bomberos 999 y policía 990 o 997.

help.en: Emergency numbers are unreliable in Malawi.
help.es: Los números de emergencia no son fiables en Malaui.
help.quote: Emergency numbers are unreliable in Malawi.

help.en: There may be other numbers for the areas you visit, so ask your hotel or the local police.
help.es: Puede haber otros números según la zona que visites; pregunta en tu hotel o a la policía local.
help.quote: There may be other numbers for the areas you visit – ask your hotel or the local police.

getting_in.en: Malawi has few international flights, with most travellers connecting through Johannesburg, Nairobi or Addis Ababa to Lilongwe or Blantyre.
getting_in.es: Malaui tiene pocos vuelos internacionales y la mayoría de viajeros conectan por Johannesburgo, Nairobi o Adís Abeba hacia Lilongwe o Blantyre.
getting_in.quote: Malawi has relatively few international flight connections, with most travelers connecting through either Johannesburg, Nairobi, or Addis Ababa to fly into Lilongwe or Blantyre.

getting_in.en: There are no international trains to Malawi.
getting_in.es: No hay trenes internacionales a Malaui.
getting_in.quote: There are no international trains to Malawi.

getting_in.en: A ferry runs twice a week from Likoma Island to Cobué and Metangula in Mozambique.
getting_in.es: Un ferri sale dos veces por semana de la isla de Likoma a Cobué y Metangula, en Mozambique.
getting_in.quote: A ferry runs twice a week from Likoma Island to Cobué and Metangula in Mozambique.

getting_in.en: The Mozambique crossing from Tete is hectic and closed at night, so plan to arrive early.
getting_in.es: El cruce desde Tete hacia Mozambique es caótico y cierra de noche, así que conviene llegar temprano.
getting_in.quote: This crossing is quite hectic, and it is closed at night, so you should plan to get there early

getting_in.en: There are no direct buses from Mbeya to Malawi, although scammers at Mbeya bus station say there are.
getting_in.es: No hay autobuses directos de Mbeya a Malaui, aunque estafadores en la estación de Mbeya dicen que sí.
getting_in.quote: There are no direct buses from Mbeya to Malawi although scammers in Mbeya bus station will tell you so, and sell you tickets.

getting_in.en: There is an excellent road from Lilongwe to Mchinji on the Zambian border.
getting_in.es: Hay una excelente carretera de Lilongwe a Mchinji, en la frontera con Zambia.
getting_in.quote: There is an excellent road from Lilongwe to Mchinji on the Zambian border (120 km).

getting_around.en: Road travel after dark is not advisable because road markings are poor and not all cars have headlights.
getting_around.es: No es aconsejable viajar por carretera de noche porque las marcas viales son deficientes y no todos los coches tienen faros.
getting_around.quote: Road travel after dark is not advisable as road markings are poor to non-existent and not all cars have headlights.

getting_around.en: Malawi has fuel shortages, so it is suggested to stock up in neighbouring countries.
getting_around.es: En Malaui hay escasez de combustible, por lo que se sugiere abastecerse en los países vecinos.
getting_around.quote: Malawi experiences fuel shortages, so stock up in neighbouring countries unless you want to queue for a long time

getting_around.en: Traffic moves on the left in Malawi, with most cars being right-hand drive.
getting_around.es: En Malaui se circula por la izquierda y la mayoría de los coches tienen el volante a la derecha.
getting_around.quote: Like many other former British colonies, traffic moves on the left in Malawi with most cars being right-hand drive.

getting_around.en: Public minibuses and pick-up trucks are often in poor condition and overloaded, while larger coaches between major towns are more reliable.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses y camionetas públicos suelen estar en mal estado y sobrecargados; los autocares entre ciudades grandes son más fiables.
getting_around.quote: Public minibuses and pick-up trucks are often in poor condition and overloaded. Larger coach services running between the major towns are more reliable.

getting_around.en: The Ilala ferry runs north from Monkey Bay to Chilumba on Fridays at 10:00.
getting_around.es: El ferri Ilala va al norte de Monkey Bay a Chilumba los viernes a las 10:00.
getting_around.quote: The Ilala ferry runs north from Monkey Bay to Chilumba on Fridays at 10:00

getting_around.en: Passenger trains are very limited, with departures 1-2 times per week between Blantyre and smaller southern cities.
getting_around.es: El servicio de trenes de pasajeros es muy limitado, con salidas 1-2 veces por semana entre Blantyre y ciudades más pequeñas del sur.
getting_around.quote: Malawi has a very limited passenger service, with departures about 1-2 times per week between Blantyre and smaller cities in Southern Malawi.

money.en: The local currency is the Malawi kwacha, abbreviated MK (MWK).
money.es: La moneda local es el kwacha malauí, abreviado MK (MWK).
money.quote: The local currency is the Malawi kwacha, sometimes abbreviated "MK" (ISO international currency code: MWK).

money.en: As of late 2025, foreigners need to pay all accommodation and related tourist services in hard currencies (USD, EUR, GBP).
money.es: Desde finales de 2025, los extranjeros deben pagar el alojamiento y servicios turísticos afines en divisas fuertes (USD, EUR, GBP).
money.quote: As of late 2025, foreigners need to pay all accommodation and related tourist services in hard currencies (USD, EUR, GBP).

money.en: MasterCard and Visa are accepted by larger hotels and large supermarkets.
money.es: MasterCard y Visa se aceptan en los hoteles grandes y los grandes supermercados.
money.quote: Credit/debit cards: MasterCard and Visa are accepted by larger hotels and large supermarkets.

money.en: Cash can be withdrawn with MasterCard or Visa at many ATMs of Standard Bank, Ecobank and National Bank of Malawi.
money.es: Se puede sacar efectivo con MasterCard o Visa en muchos cajeros de Standard Bank, Ecobank y National Bank of Malawi.
money.quote: You can withdraw cash using a MasterCard or Visa card at many ATMs of the Standard Bank, Ecobank, National Bank of Malawi.

money.en: Travellers' cheques can no longer be used.
money.es: Los cheques de viaje ya no se pueden usar.
money.quote: Travellers' cheques can no longer be used.

money.en: The central bank devalued the kwacha by 44% in November 2023.
money.es: El banco central devaluó el kwacha un 44% en noviembre de 2023.
money.quote: The central bank devalued the kwacha by 44% in Nov 2023.

etiquette.en: Malawians are extremely courteous, which includes shaking hands, speaking softly and addressing others with respect.
etiquette.es: Los malauíes son extremadamente corteses: dan la mano, hablan en voz baja y tratan a los demás con respeto.
etiquette.quote: Malawians are in general extremely courteous, and a part of that courtesy is shaking hands, speaking softly, and referring to travellers and others with respect.

etiquette.en: Women should not wear shorts or mini-skirts, especially outside the lodge or camp.
etiquette.es: Las mujeres no deberían llevar pantalones cortos ni minifaldas, sobre todo fuera del alojamiento o campamento.
etiquette.quote: Culturally, women should not wear shorts or mini-skirts, especially when travelling outside the lodge or camp.

etiquette.en: When meeting a Malawian you should always say hello and ask how they are.
etiquette.es: Al conocer a un malauí siempre debes saludar y preguntarle cómo está.
etiquette.quote: Finally, when meeting a Malawian — even to ask a question — you should always say hello and ask how they are.

etiquette.en: Malawian men often hold hands while chatting, which should not be given a sexual interpretation.
etiquette.es: Los hombres malauíes suelen cogerse de la mano al conversar, y esto no debe interpretarse de forma sexual.
etiquette.quote: It is common for Malawi men to hold hands when they've gathered together to chat, and this shouldn't be given a sexual interpretation when it is encountered.

etiquette.en: Visitors should be prepared to be greeted by kids yelling mzungu and to answer many questions about themselves.
etiquette.es: Los visitantes deben estar preparados para que los niños les griten mzungu y para responder muchas preguntas sobre sí mismos.
etiquette.quote: Be prepared to be greeted by kids yelling mzungu, mzungu! and to answer lots of questions about yourself.

etiquette.en: Outside the main tourist areas, dress conservatively to avoid offending local sensitivities.
etiquette.es: Fuera de las zonas turísticas principales, viste de forma conservadora para no ofender sensibilidades locales.
etiquette.quote: Outside the main tourist areas, dress conservatively to avoid offending local sensitivities.

connectivity.en: The two main mobile providers are Airtel and TNM, and SIM cards cost 200 MK.
connectivity.es: Los dos principales operadores móviles son Airtel y TNM, y las SIM cuestan 200 MK.
connectivity.quote: The two main mobile network providers are Airtel and TNM. For 3G TNM has better coverage with Airtel only really covering the largest cities. SIM cards are available for 200 MK.
